Still unlikely. The persistence of the 07:00-09:10 outdoor block across multiple days, including the addition of a newspaper/breakfast ritual, suggests a deliberate leisure or work routine rather than a missed commute. No evidence of departure for work.
Contradicted by consistent early morning activity (07:04-09:10) across 4 days. The resident is clearly active and engaged in morning rituals, not sleeping in.
